subject: Copywriting
title: The Future of Truth
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Future of Truth.

hook.text: We live in the first era where anyone can reach millions with propaganda.

buildup.text: AI generates convincing text, images, and video at scale. Bots amplify messages. Attribution is nearly impossible.

discovery.text: Some solutions are emerging: content provenance standards, digital watermarks, and blockchain-verified media.

twist.text: But technology alone can't solve a human problem.

climax.text: The Future of Truth matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: Technology verifies; culture values. The future of truth needs both.

quiz.question: What two things does the future of truth depend on?
options: Technology for verification and cultures that value truth
